        loadContinuation 0%nat loaded) -∗
      ∃ index : nat,
        ⌜Z.of_nat index = (decodeItemInputPointer args + 0 - decodeItemInputPointer args) `div` 1⌝ ∗
        ⌜(index < length (decodeItemInputBytes args))%nat⌝ ∗
